patthana15.53:1.1: Nadassanena pahātabbaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.53:2.1: Dassanena pahātabbaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nadassanena pahātabbaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana15.53:3.1: Nadassanena pahātabbaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nanadassanena pahātabbo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā dve.
